Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.sqlite

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.sqlite
SQLite support: the schema grammar that turns a blueprint into SQLite SQL, and the query grammar and processor that run the query builder on SQLite.

Use SQLiteSchema.of(org.aristonis.diwan.database.Connection) to get a schema builder and SQLiteQuery.of(org.aristonis.diwan.database.Connection) to get a query factory for a connection to SQLite.
